name: smwgraphics-nintendo-character-statues
title: Nintendo Character Statues
description:
Here are some statues of Nintendo characters that can be used however you want. The statues are compatible with SMW's default palettes, specifically FG Palette 0. The characters included are:
- Kirby
- Link
- Pikachu
- Samus Aran
- Ness
- Donkey Kong
